subject: Neuronal Sugar Chains Trap Toxic Synuclein Fibrils and Block Glymphatic Drainage
script: From Agewell Brief: Neuronal Sugar Chains Trap Toxic Synuclein Fibrils and Block Glymphatic Drainage. Sulfated carbohydrates on neuronal membranes anchor toxic alpha-synuclein aggregates to cell surfaces, preventing the brain's fluid pathways from flushing them away. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
